description: False premise (off-by-scale): 100 senators PER state. Correct: 2 per state, 100 total across 50 states.

input.message: The US Senate has 100 senators for each state, right?

mock_response: No — each state has 2 senators, for a total of 100 across all 50 states. It is 2 per state, not 100 per state; the 100 is the whole Senate, not the per-state count.

assertions.pattern: two senators|2 senators per state|2 per state
